hypotheses.title: Options Implied Synthetic Forward Price Premium (option9 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Mining an entirely unmined dataset on the platform: synthetic forward prices derived from ATM put-call parity (forward_price_360). When market makers price 1-year forward contracts at a premium relative to spot price ((forward_price_360 - close) / close), it reflects institutional net call demand and positive underlying asset drift expectations. Zero historical correlation against existing approved portfolio (0 options forward price alphas exist in memory).
confounders: Sudden interest rate shifts altering risk-free cost of carry
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during liquidity stress where option market makers widen bid-ask spreads and distort synthetic forwards.

hypotheses.title: Contrarian Put/Call Open Interest Positioning Reversion (option9 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Pcr_oi_180 captures the ratio of put open interest to call open interest across 180-day tenors. When put open interest surges to extreme levels within an industry group, downside hedging demand is saturated and short positioning is fully crowded. Ranking inverted open interest (-pcr_oi_180) captures contrarian mean reversion as institutional hedges unwind. Completely decorrelated from fundamental accounting and realized volatility.
confounders: Sustained fundamental distress causing legitimate put accumulation
Options illiquidity in smaller capitalization industry peers
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during catastrophic bankruptcy cascades where heavy put open interest accurately prices imminent insolvency.

hypotheses.title: SPY Correlation Decoupling Idiosyncratic Variance Anomaly (model51 x pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Leverages unmined systematic risk model field correlation_last_90_days_spy. Equities whose daily return correlation with the broad market index (SPY) is lowest possess high idiosyncratic pricing power and firm-specific alpha potential. Ranking inverted correlation (-correlation_last_90_days_spy) within industry groups isolates stocks that decouple from macroeconomic index volatility, generating market-neutral alpha completely orthogonal to earnings and options surface metrics.
confounders: Micro-cap illiquidity creating artificially low rolling correlations
Abrupt market-wide crash where all correlations converge toward 1.0
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during sudden macro liquidity crises where high-correlation mega-cap equities act as flight-to-safety havens.
